description: Make rendered and validated with-input the sole built-in Action input channel, explicitly bind local and GitHub PR delivery profiles, remove issue-backed delivery cross-checks, and enforce a Variable-free Action invocation boundary.

tasks.title: Remove hidden OpenCode and OpenSpec Variable inputs
tasks.description: Migrate the non-delivery OpenCode and OpenSpec Action paths away from effective Variables while preserving their declared prompt and task behavior. Remove the prompt-loader Variable bag, rely on the profile-declared nested build prompt, and make archive retry idempotence derive from workspace/archive state instead of Run Variable persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: `mohist/opencode` prompt resolution and every registered prompt loader receive declared loader input and host workDir but no effective or Run Variables
`mohist/openspec-tasks` does not read `variables.prompts.build`; generated tasks preserve the explicitly declared `${{ prompts.build }}` nested prompt template through late dispatch expansion
`mohist/archive-change` neither reads `_actions.archiveChange.destination` or `openspecArchiveName` nor writes archive-name retry state to Run Variables

Archive retries after a completed move locate the intended archive deterministically across collision suffixes and date rollover, and ambiguous matches fail without staging or committing the wrong directory
Focused OpenCode prompt-loader, OpenSpec task generation, archive first-run, retry-after-move, collision, and failure tests use fake filesystem/process boundaries and no wall-clock waits
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner` pass
tasks.output: Variable-independent OpenCode prompt loading and OpenSpec task/archive implementations with focused Runner regressions under packages/runner/.
tasks.notes: Keep rawWith only for the declared composite task input whose nested templates must survive until generated-task dispatch. Do not add buildPrompt/archiveName compatibility inputs or change template syntax.

tasks.title: Deliver explicit local Git Action contracts
tasks.spec: specs/action-input-sourcing/spec.md#Former implicit inputs are declared and enforced, specs/builtin-profile-input-bindings/spec.md#Bundled profiles bind affected Action inputs explicitly, specs/builtin-profile-input-bindings/spec.md#Local profile behavior is preserved with explicit inputs
tasks.description: Switch workspace preparation and local Git delivery Actions to manifest-declared branch and remote inputs, removing their Variable fallbacks and issue-backed value checks. Update both bundled profiles wherever they consume these shared Actions, with complete local-profile routing, recovery, documentation, and regression coverage delivered atomically with the stricter manifests.
acceptanceCriteria: `mohist/workspace-prepare` requires `expectedBranch`; every bundled stage passes `${{ workspace.branch }}` and the handler always uses host workDir

`mohist/rebase` and `mohist/rebase-status` require `baseBranch`; `mohist/merge-ready` requires `baseBranch`, `source`, and `remote`; `mohist/push` requires `source`, `target`, and `remote`, with the duplicate push `baseBranch` alias removed
Missing required Git inputs fail during manifest validation with field-specific `invalid-input` before any fake Git runner call, even when equivalent values exist in dispatch Variables
Valid explicit branch and remote inputs are used unchanged and are not rejected or replaced when issue-backed repository/workspace Variables disagree
`mohist/local` retains plan/build/check/integrate order, approvals, merge-ready recovery, rebase-squash integration, and direct push to the explicitly bound repository base branch

All workspace-prepare, push, rebase, and merge-ready uses in `mohist/local` and `mohist/github-pr`, including approval feedback and recovery tasks, satisfy the new manifests through visible with-bindings
Action catalog expectations and Git/workspace Action documentation list the same required/default inputs and no Variable fallback
Focused Runner Action/manifest/profile tests and Server parsed-profile specs cover the explicit bindings and unchanged local flow
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner`, and `npm test` pass
tasks.output: Explicit workspace/rebase/merge-ready/push manifests and handlers, updated bundled Git bindings, local workflow regressions, and matching Action documentation.
tasks.notes: This task updates shared Git uses in the GitHub profile so the stricter manifests never leave a shipped profile undispatchable. GitHub PR repository scoping remains for T-003.

tasks.title: Deliver explicit GitHub PR Action contracts
tasks.spec: specs/action-input-sourcing/spec.md#Declared delivery inputs are authoritative for the invocation, specs/builtin-profile-input-bindings/spec.md#GitHub PR profile behavior is preserved with explicit inputs
tasks.description: Make GitHub PR creation, ready transition, merge, and status use explicit repository and PR inputs, then remove delivery-context fallback and cross-check code once no caller needs it. Update the GitHub PR profile, recoveries, catalog, documentation, and full-flow tests in the same feature slice.
acceptanceCriteria: `mohist/create-github-pr` requires `repositoryUrl`, `source`, and `target`; ready requires `repositoryUrl` and `prNumber`; merge requires `repositoryUrl` and `prNumber`; status requires `repositoryUrl` and `prNumber`
GitHub handlers derive the `gh --repo` selector only from the validated `repositoryUrl`, use host workDir, and never infer repository or PR identity from Variables or current issue repository context
`merge-github-pr` no longer discovers a PR through source/target fallback, and GitHub Actions do not declare or consume an unused Git remote input

Declared repository, branch, and PR values execute unchanged when hidden issue/repository Variables disagree; invalid repository URLs and credential/permission failures retain actionable existing error categories
Issue field selectors for PR text and squash subjects use dispatch project/issue identity only when explicitly selected and do not fall back to Variable-based identity

The GitHub PR profile binds `${{ repository.gitUrl }}` to every GitHub Action, preserves `${{ vars.github.pr.number }}` bindings for ready/merge/status consumers, and removes the unused create-PR remote field
Draft creation/output projection, reviewed-branch publication, ready transition, status checks, squash merge, base-moved recovery, and failed-check recovery retain their existing order and behavior
`delivery-context.ts` and tests that assert authoritative issue cross-check rejection are removed or replaced by explicit-input behavior tests
Catalog and user documentation describe the final GitHub Action inputs without repository, branch, or PR Variable fallbacks
Focused Runner GitHub Action tests and Server GitHub profile specs pass without real network access
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner`, and `npm test` pass
tasks.output: Explicit GitHub PR manifests/handlers and repository parsing, updated mohist/github-pr profile and recoveries, deleted delivery fallback guard, documentation, and full-flow regressions.
tasks.notes: Credentials remain the authorization boundary. Do not add Server dispatch policy, a new repository expression, or compatibility fallback for old profile snapshots.

tasks.title: Enforce the Variable-free Action invocation boundary
tasks.spec: specs/action-input-sourcing/spec.md#Built-in Action inputs have one source, specs/action-input-sourcing/spec.md#Published Action contracts expose every supported input
tasks.description: Close the input channel structurally after all concrete built-ins have migrated: project a runtime Action context without Variables, narrow the TypeScript invocation types and built-in signatures, and remove unsafe casts that could recover the old context. Audit catalog/docs and run the complete Runner and Server regression suites to prove that engine Variable use remains limited to rendering, workspace resolution, recovery, and setVars.
acceptanceCriteria: The object passed to `ActionDefinition.run` has no `variables` property at runtime, and `ValidatedActionContext` plus built-in handler types do not expose one at compile time
The executor still renders `${{ vars.* }}` before validation, freezes the rendered value for the invocation, resolves host workDir, evaluates recovery, and applies setVars with unchanged semantics
A boundary test proves a custom Action cannot observe `variables` while it receives validated with-input and the resolved host workDir
Production built-ins contain no `context.variables` reads and no cast restores a Variable-bearing Action context; rawWith remains limited to declared generated-task template propagation
Every runtime-affecting built-in input appears in its manifest-derived catalog entry and user documentation, and documented Variable examples bind through `with`
No Server policy validation, template namespace/syntax change, or broad Action capability-host redesign is introduced
Runner typecheck, test-boundary checks, unit/spec tests, and relevant Server profile tests cover tasks and individual checks with no real external dependency or wall-clock timing
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run test:ci -w packages/runner`, and `npm test` pass
tasks.output: Variable-free Action invocation projection and types, migrated built-in signatures, boundary/catalog/documentation audits, and complete Runner/Server verification.
tasks.notes: This is the enforcement slice, not the full capability-based ActionHost redesign. It depends on every concrete migration so narrowing the runtime context does not require temporary compatibility accessors.
